k-ansem.title: Ansem wallet sells $ANSEM, hack disputed
k-ansem.sourceSays: Posts say wallets linked to Ansem sold tens of millions of $ANSEM and moved ~$2.5M USDC to Arbitrum; a hack is suspected but unconfirmed, and an analyst disputes it.
k-ansem.reason: Nov 24 posts from news accounts describe the $ANSEM selloff and the disputed hack claim; Scamsem and the new Black Bull coins launched after it began.

k-bull.title: Post-ANSEM new bull mascot coins
k-bull.sourceSays: Posts say traders are looking for a new 'bull' after the $ANSEM selloff, pitching Jack Duval (White Bull) or Cupsey; others call the bull meta useless.
k-bull.reason: Nov 24 posts tie the DUVAL, Green Bull and Black Bull launches to the ANSEM dump and a search for a replacement mascot; posts are partly promotional.
